scenes.text: You probably think of trees as completely still and rooted forever in one spot, but deep in the dense Latin American rainforest, a truly bizarre species is actually walking across the jungle floor.
Known as the walking palm, this unbelievable tree can travel up to twenty meters in a single year by growing long, stilt-like roots that look exactly like woody legs.
When thick canopy shade blocks its light, the tree sprouts new roots toward the sunshine, allowing the old, useless roots to slowly rot away as the entire trunk physically shifts.
It is literally moving itself to stay alive in a competitive environment, so would you be creeped out if you saw this tree crawling? Tell me in the comments and follow for more!

meta.title: The terrifying reason this tree is slowly walking away #shorts
